en: A sepia-toned historic view of a broad European square with tree‑lined streets, horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians. In the center stands an ornate Marian or Holy Trinity column on a stepped pedestal, surrounded by a low fence. Behind it rises a domed church with a tower and cross, flanked by long, classical multi‑story buildings. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard layout with address lines and stamp boxes, and printed captions identifying the scene and publisher.
